review:
The book formula with respins. On any base-game spin, a random symbol can be picked to expand, triggering a respin – and it keeps going while that symbol keeps landing.

Three or more books give 10 free spins, and here you choose your expanding symbol instead of leaving it to chance. Expanding it again triggers more respins, and three more books retrigger. 96.5% RTP. Livelier than a standard book slot.
